ShortDescription.Value: Keeps residential, commercial, industrial and office demand maxed so zoned buildings keep growing. Toggle each zone type in Options.

Publish.LongDescription:
Keeps zone demand at maximum so your zoned lots keep filling with buildings.
**What it does** - Fills the demand bars for low, medium and high density residential, commercial, industrial and office zones. - Also raises the per-product demand the game uses to pick which shop, factory or office to build. Mods that only fill the bars leave commercial and industrial zones empty; this one makes them grow. - Fills the new buildings: brings in households faster while homes stand empty, and keeps shops, factories and offices arriving while business buildings stand empty. Both stop on their own once buildings are full, so no homeless crowds or endless company queues. - Optional: warehouses, and a "build anywhere" switch that uses the game's built-in fast-spawn mode to ignore location and demand.
**Settings** Options > Infinite Zone Demand. Every zone type can be switched on or off while playing; switching one off returns it to normal demand within a few seconds.
**Notes** - No Harmony patches. Safe to remove at any time; demand goes back to normal on the next simulation update. - Buildings still need workers, customers and services to thrive. Forced growth can mean more empty or struggling businesses than a normal city. - Not compatible with other mods that override demand (e.g. Super Fast Building And Leveling's demand sliders, Unlimited Demand).
